name: Chrome enforces Enhanced Safe Browsing
description: Web filtering. Only a policy counts: the SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel of 2 has to come from a configuration profile, device-wide or per user, and no profile may set it lower. A setting the user chose lives in Chrome's own profile, which cannot be read here and could be switched off again. A machine without Chrome passes.
query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM apps WHERE bundle_identifier = 'com.google.Chrome') AS installed, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT value FROM plist WHERE path = '/Library/Managed Preferences/com.google.Chrome.plist' AND key = 'SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel' UNION ALL SELECT value FROM plist WHERE path LIKE '/Library/Managed Preferences/%/com.google.Chrome.plist' AND key = 'SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel')) AS enforced, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT value FROM plist WHERE path = '/Library/Managed Preferences/com.google.Chrome.plist' AND key = 'SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel' UNION ALL SELECT value FROM plist WHERE path LIKE '/Library/Managed Preferences/%/com.google.Chrome.plist' AND key = 'SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel') WHERE value != '2') AS weaker;
